title: ProjectRegistered@1
description: The first event of a Project Store's log (ADR-0157): the Project's identity, derived from the repository's root commits, and the `[project] name` and `min_af` of the registering checkout's `.af/af.toml` when that file parses. Never a path or a remote URL.

workspace_id.description: `w-` + the first 16 hex digits of SHA-256(`af/workspace-id@1\0` || Project ID || `\0` || canonical checkout path): opaque, never the path itself.

label.description: The Workspace's label, unique within its Project: the safe-name rule of Task IDs.

unix_ms.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch, as canonical decimal text.

repository_id.description: The repository's sorted, distinct root commits joined by `,`, exactly as every Snapshot origin carries it.
